summary: Fastidious and OddOneGaming analyze the anniversary summon banners to advise players on optimal summon priorities. The Reversal Summon banner featuring Child of Chaos is an absolute priority and must-pull, as he is an ultra-versatile element-swapping support who may not return soon. In contrast, Mithrasea is powercrept and outclassed by non-premium supports like Acilia, making her banner an easy skip. Additionally, permanent or recurring banners like First Blush Summons and Selected Summons should not distract players from limited-time opportunities. Finally, players obtaining a second copy of Child of Chaos should avoid rushing his exclusive artifact, since Inspiration 1 can be tested and reset freely.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Extremely versatile support who can change elements to fit any team; guaranteed at 300 pulls on his limited 2-week Reversal Summon banner.

heroes.name: Mithrasea
heroes.note: Heavily powercrept over time and considered worse and less versatile than standard non-premium supports like Acilia.

heroes.name: Acilia
heroes.note: More versatile than Mithrasea and capable of acting as a solo defensive support for full teams.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Top non-premium damage dealer for Burn teams that outperforms many premium options in that archetype.

meta_changes: Mithrasea has fallen out of the high-end support meta due to long ultimate recharge times and superior alternatives like Acilia.
tips: Focus all resources on the Reversal Summon banner for Child of Chaos; the banner unlocks on Day 5 of an account and lasts 14 days.
Banners have a hidden hard pity guaranteeing a premium legendary at 1,000 summons if one hasn't been pulled earlier (standard legendary pity is 70 summons).
Do not summon on the First Blush banner until limited banners finish, as First Blush has no expiration timer.

If you pull a second copy of Child of Chaos, test Inspiration 1 before exchanging for his exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst, because inspirations can be freely reset while artifact crafting is permanent.
